info.name: Cassini source capture
info.summary: Loads Cassini's opt-in source-audio recorder on Talk calls.
info.description: Companion app for the Cassini recording ExApp. It uses Nextcloud's public LoadAdditionalScriptsEvent hook to load Cassini's participant-opt-in source audio capture on authenticated Talk call pages. It does not record, receive, or store audio itself; the gocassini ExApp remains responsible for consent, collection, upload, and ingestion policy. The feature is experimental and off by default.
info.author: codemyriad
